relationships.rationale: The wizard approval snapshot race is a specific projection of the wider HITL transactional-seam problem, but it has a distinct source-report lifecycle.
Shortcut import collision outcomes depend on the registry collision policy while retaining a separate import lifecycle and unknown-action behavior.
Generic route/open command outcomes consume the shared route payload trust contract, while command receipts and persistence behavior remain a distinct lifecycle.
Route-aware recovery depends on generic route/open dispositions, but adds restore identity, stale-target, fallback, and recovery states.
Canonical work-root authentication strengthens the lane-scoped cleanup authority contract without sharing its validation lifecycle.
Concurrent-run leasing extends lane-scoped cleanup authority with an exclusivity lifecycle and refusal behavior.
The conflicting global cleanup default and the two meanings of absent CleanupConfig can jointly produce unsafe implicit broad cleanup.
Cancellation-safe and startup-reconciled cleanup depends on durable process identity and process-tree ownership.
Exact deletion preview strengthens the general destructive-action confirmation guard for the manual cleanup lifecycle.
Restore eligibility decisions depend on stable project identity while retaining separate decision-record and failure-reason semantics.
Child timeout supervision needs a trustworthy cross-platform process-liveness result, whose permission-denied behavior is a separate platform concern.
Child budgets and timeout supervision interact with cross-runtime quota and pressure control, but have distinct termination and recovery lifecycles.
Provider eligibility uses recent-failure freshness evidence and therefore interacts with the platform freshness model, while account/model filtering remains provider-specific.
